name: Iran
description: Follow Iran, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: An Emerging Deal Between Iran and Oman to Reopen Hormuz Would Come at a Cost for Trump
changes.summary: The deal would address President Trump’s most urgent political problem by allowing ships to move again. But it would give Iran strategic leverage it did not have before the war.

changes.title: 8/3: The Takeout with Major Garrett
changes.summary: Trump says he's giving Iran a "last chance" at diplomacy; Blanche one step closer to confirmation as attorney general.

changes.title: Sailors Working in Strait of Hormuz Are Caught in Crossfire of Iran War
changes.summary: Thousands of civilian workers remain stranded on ships at risk of attack by Iran. On one vessel, sailors have been held by the Iranian navy for more than three months.

changes.title: Oil Giant Saudi Aramco Reports 33% Profit Surge, Despite Iran War Disruptions
changes.summary: Higher oil prices propelled a quarterly earnings jump for Saudi Arabia’s energy giant, which used pipelines to work around disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz.

changes.title: How the War in Iran Is Complicating Trump’s Agenda at Home
changes.summary: As President Trump heads to the West Coast to talk to Americans about the economy, the war in Iran is driving up costs and polls show the already unpopular conflict is losing support.

changes.title: Oil Prices Plummet as Investors Digest Pause in Iran War Fighting
changes.summary: The markets’ moves were the first since President Trump said he had halted a planned U.S. assault on Iran.

changes.title: Trump says new talks are 'last chance' for Iran to forge a deal
changes.summary: Trump said in the Oval Office on Monday he expects negotiations that will reopen the Strait of Hormuz and create a pathway for Iran to address the United States' concerns about its nuclear program will begin in the next day or two.

changes.title: Takeaways after Trump takes questions on Iran, Reflecting Pool in Oval Office
changes.summary: President Trump took reporter questions on the Iran war, the renovation of the reflecting pool in Washington, D.C., and more on Monday. CBS News' Lindsey Reiser and Natalie Brand share their biggest takeaways.

changes.title: Trump gives Iran ‘last chance’ to make deal before U.S. ‘decapitation’ strikes
changes.summary: President Trump said Iran in falsely claiming it is not negotiating with the U.S. Trump said the Iranian regime is discussing ending its attacks on commercial ships in the Strait of Hormuz. NBC News’ Keir Simmons reports.

changes.title: Investigators probe whether Iran was behind cyberattack on water systems in 7 states
changes.summary: Investigators are looking into whether Iran was behind cyberattacks on public water systems in at least seven states. Officials in Michigan and Minnesota say their water systems are operating safely after the attacks. CBS News cybersecurity expert and analyst Chris Krebs explains what to know.
